title: 📱 iQOO 16 Nears India… A Store Page Appears Suddenly and Confirms a December Launch!
body: 📱 iQOO 16 Nears India… A Store Page Appears Suddenly and Confirms a December Launch!

A dedicated page for the iQOO 16 phone briefly appeared on Amazon's store in India, before being quickly pulled — a strong sign that the phone's launch in the country is very near, with reports pointing to a date in December.

The company's head in India had previously confirmed that the phone would launch in the country soon, without giving a date, and the phone was also showcased at the India Mobile Congress, while its Indian version appeared on the Geekbench benchmarking platform with 12 GB of memory and Android 17, scoring 2,944 points in single-core and 10,029 in multi-core.

The phone runs on the Snapdragon 8 Elite Extreme Gen 6 processor built on 2-nanometre technology, with its main core reaching speeds of 5.01 GHz, alongside a 6.85-inch AMOLED display with 2K resolution and a 165 Hz refresh rate, an 8,400 mAh battery with 100W wired and 40W wireless charging, and the OriginOS 7 interface built on Android 17.

The phone had launched in China in September at a starting price of 5,999 Chinese yuan for the base version with 12 GB of memory and 256 GB of storage, and the company has not yet announced the final Indian launch date or its price there.
Simply put: a store page appearing before the official announcement is like a party date leaking before the invitation... Has the launch become a matter of days?
If your next phone has an 8,400 battery and 100W charging, is a full day without a charger enough for you?
